dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: I'm the descendant of the oldest aristocratic family in the desert, which is basically synonymous with wealth itself.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: It's too bad. Researchers who are not from Vahu{RUBY#[S]Aetiology}mana would never understand the value of this status. City folk these days...

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: It's not merely a problem about Mora, but also wisdom and courage.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Whether it's Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's legacy or King Deshret's relics, all can be found in my family's treasury.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: The estate left to me by my ancestors will continue to flourish in my hands.
